title: 森の精霊
lead: 苔・どんぐり・きのこ・霧などから生まれた、オリジナルの森の精霊12体の素材です。絵本、ゲーム、雑貨のデザインに使えます。
subject_en: ORIGINAL gentle forest spirit creatures invented for this series (no existing character or franchise), each a small separate creature with a distinct silhouette, simple calm face and a natural material motif, one signature colour each. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a round moss-green spirit with tiny leaves on its head
a small spirit wearing an acorn cap hat
a spirit with a red spotted mushroom cap body
a soft pale-blue misty spirit with a trailing tail
a spirit shaped like an orange maple leaf with little feet
a light-blue water droplet spirit with a ripple pattern
a brown spirit with root-like legs and a mossy back
a small yellow glowing spirit with tiny wings
a round pale spirit with snowflake ears
a spirit with a pink flower for a head
a grey rounded stone spirit with a little sprout on top
a pale green swirl spirit holding a dandelion puff
